^Connectome online. Baseline warmth intact. Optical array clear across ten light-years of empty dark.

intro_whisper_target1_done: ^Locked—ten light-years to the decimal. Good. Now you know where the porch light is.
intro_sibling_first_call: ^Oh good, you picked up. Talking to myself across fourteen minutes of dark is weirdly comforting.
